scenario: Leaf-level error matching per LECC.6.2 — `error adapter.throttled:` pins to the one leaf and does NOT match other `adapter.*` codes (per LCCO.8.3.2 segment-boundary matching). Pin: an `error adapter.throttled:` clause compiles. PINS ONLY THAT IT COMPILES: `compile_ok` observes neither the predicate the sibling rule is keyed on nor that other `adapter.*` codes are not caught.
rules_ds:
service weather.get_forecasts:
    kwarg entity_id: String
    no response

schema TimeOfDay scope ttl 1_min:
    state: String

rule daily_forecast:
    TimeOfDay t where t.state == "18:00"
->
    call weather.get_forecasts entity_id: "weather.home" cooldown: 23_h
        error adapter.throttled:
            log info "throttled"
